name: NAMD
summary: Molecular dynamics engine for large biomolecular systems.

steps: Read the current official NAMD download page and non-commercial license; the user must register or log in to obtain official archives.
Choose the official archive for the exact OS, architecture, CPU/GPU and network setup. Windows users may also choose WSL for recent Linux builds.
Download under the user's own account, inspect the archive and maintainer instructions, then extract to a user-controlled directory without changing system-wide paths.
install.verify_note: Run the executable's documented startup or version check from the selected archive; conduct a small tutorial simulation only as a separate scientific test.

notes: Registration and license acceptance cannot be delegated to this installer; commercial use requires separate terms. Do not redistribute official archives.
